Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
I have Heidelburg Castle in play and a minion with a melee weapon has just
finished combat. May I tap HC to transfer the weapon to another minion
before playing Hidden Lurker and enter combat with that minion?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.
Heidelburg Castle cannot be used during an action.
